CHAPTER 15 · ITEM 14 / 14

Long-run equilibrium and changes

Input costs, technology and patents投入成本、技術與專利

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Analyze a change in an input price or a firm's technology: shift the appropriate cost curves, determine short-run profits, and trace potential long-run industry adjustment. Consider whether a patented innovation can be copied when assessing entry or competition.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

投入價升提高相關 VC、MC，令市場供給左移。技術進步可降成本；先求短期價與利潤再判斷進出。專利可暫時阻止其他企業複製優勢。

An input-price increase raises relevant variable costs and MC, shifting market supply left. Technology can lower costs; trace the short-run price and profits before deciding entry or exit. A patent can keep an innovator's advantage from being copied until it expires.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：One firm's patented process lowers its cost while market price barely changes. It earns extra profit; after expiry, broad adoption can lower market price. 專利到期後優勢可能擴散。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

A patented cost reduction is available only to one small firm. Its immediate profit at an unchanged price? 價不變、單一小企業專利降成本？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
